name: BIOBUZZ
_comment: The 2026-2027 FTC game is BIOBUZZ presented by RTX. These are the stats
scouts record for it, built against the Competition Manual version TU05.
Rules change through Team Updates: re-check manual sections 10.5 and 13.6
before each event. See docs/ftc/FTC_BETA_PLAN.md section 3.
Point values are given only where one robot directly earns them under
Table 10-2 (LEAVE 3, PARK 5, GARDEN 1 each). Everything else starts at 0;
launch weights stay 0 until the HIVE TIP threshold is measured, and a lead
scout tunes them on the day through the runtime overrides (L12).
Every field is something one scout can see one robot do and finish within
the field reset (F8). Launches are counted as they leave the robot, not
where they land: a spilling HIVE shared by two robots cannot be judged per
element, so landing is one accuracy choice after the match. FLOWER
ownership (whose NECTAR is on top at the buzzer) is an alliance result read
off the score sheet, so it is not asked. Counter caps are ceilings no robot
should reach, not expected values. Rationale per field:
docs/ftc/FTC_BETA_SCHEMA_REVIEW.md.
This file is the single source of truth for three things at once: the
scouting form's fields, the validation applied to submitted payloads, and
the point values used for team ranking. Change it here and all three follow.
Field keys are payload keys. Renaming one breaks existing data -- add a new
field and bump 'version' instead. crates/tt-core/src/season.rs validates this
file on every test run, so a typo here is a red build, not an event-day
surprise. See docs/plan/ACTION_ITEMS.md D4.

fields.label: Robot status
fields.help: Anything but Played: pick it and skip what the robot did not do.

fields.label: Auto launches
fields.help: Every element it launched at the HIVE, in or not. Tap as each one leaves the robot.

fields.label: Teleop launches
fields.help: Every element it launched at the HIVE, in or not, endgame included.

fields.label: Launch accuracy
fields.help: After the match, auto and teleop together. Leave it blank if it never launched.

fields.label: Elements into own GARDEN
fields.help: Pushed or placed, endgame included. A lower bound: opponents can remove them.

fields.label: NECTAR placed in FLOWERS
fields.help: FLOWERS open at 1:00 left. The alliance has 8 NECTAR.

fields.label: FLOWER role
fields.help: The most it did. Bottom NECTAR: its NECTAR went into an empty FLOWER. Who owns the top comes from the score sheet.

fields.label: Driver skill
fields.help: Against the other three robots in this match.

fields.label: Fouls seen
fields.help: What you saw. Official fouls come from the score sheet.

fields.label: Rule incidents
fields.help: e.g. held 5+ elements, hit the HIVE, pin. Visible only to your own team.

fields.label: Anything the numbers miss
fields.help: Visible only to your own team.
